sharedPrompt.format: One full-bleed illustration that fills the whole image edge to edge. Flat 2D illustration, no 3D rendering, no photorealism.
sharedPrompt.artStyle: 1980s Japanese anime cel animation, hand-painted cel shading with hard-edged two-tone shadows, thick clean ink linework, airbrushed painted backgrounds, retro sci-fi OVA aesthetic circa 1985-1989, muted pastel and neon palette with deep blues, violet and teal, accents of neon sunset orange, chrome silver and warm cream, soft film grain, slight VHS chromatic bloom, large expressive eyes with sharp angular highlights, angular jawlines, voluminous feathered hair, lens flare star-glints, analog film look. Overall mood: dramatic, heroic and a little cheesy, like a VHS box cover.
frame: Border: a thick border of dark navy blue with a bevelled chrome-silver edge, a fine neon teal grid pattern like a retro synthwave floor, and a thin stripe of sunset colours (orange to violet) running along the inside edge.
Top-left corner: a small round set emblem of a bright four-pointed lens-flare star glint over a tiny striped sunset, with no letters.
Top: an empty name banner shaped like a long bevelled chrome bar with angled ends, pale silver-white inside a darker chrome edge, about 10% of the card height, with no letters in it.

Bottom: a text panel below the window, about 30% of the card height, in pale warm cream with a thin dark navy edge. The top third of the panel is empty space for two lines of text. A thin navy divider line runs across the panel below that space.

Stats grid: the lower two-thirds of the panel is split into six equal cells, in two rows of three, by thin navy dividers. All six cells are pale cream. Each cell has one small bold icon on its left side, no wider than a quarter of the cell, and the right three-quarters of the cell is empty space for a word like 'COURAGE' and a large number. The icons, top row left to right: a clenched fist; a lightning bolt; a gear. Bottom row left to right: a flame; a narrowed eye; a pair of sunglasses. The icons are simple, flat and bold, in navy, teal, violet and sunset orange.

Card number: below the panel, on the border, in the bottom-right corner only, one wide empty dark navy plaque with a chrome edge for the card number, about 22% of the card width, so it can hold text like '#50 of 50'. The bottom-left corner has no badge, only border. The plaque is empty, with no letters.
Accent colours on the frame are only navy, teal, violet, sunset orange, chrome silver and cream. Do not use pink, magenta or hot pink anywhere on the frame.
sharedPrompt.negative: No 3D render, no CGI, no modern digital anime, no cel-shaded 3D, no photorealism, no smooth gradients on characters, no chibi, no moe style, no watermark, no text, no signature, no real or existing anime, cartoon or film characters, no logos.

rulesCard.title: How to Play
steps: Two players. Deal all the cards evenly.
Each player shuffles their cards into a face-down deck.
Each player turns over their top card and looks at it.
The winner of the last round picks a stat. In the first round, the player with the biggest hair picks.
Reveal the cards. The higher value in the called stat wins.
The winner keeps both cards in their own pile. On a tie, each player keeps their own card.
When your deck runs out, shuffle your pile to make a new deck.
You win when your opponent has no cards left. Hero or villain, only one can stand!
